## Project focus {.flow}

::: {.card fill="false" title="The decision this project supports"}
How can PhD Orthodontics improve digital visibility and the path toward consultation inquiries? The project connects website experience, SEO, content, paid media, and consumer research. Chino Hills is a proposed expansion context; this dashboard makes no claim of operating performance there.

**Phase represented:** research design and baseline preparation. Findings and recommendations require validated evidence.
:::

## Objectives and evidence {.flow}

### Column {width=55%}

::: {.card fill="false" title="Five complementary analytics objectives"}
| AO | Focus | Audience question |
|:--|:--|:--|
| AO1 | Website / UX | Can visitors find information and a clear next step? |
| AO2 | SEO | Can relevant searchers discover the practice? |
| AO3 | Content | Does the information address prospective patients’ questions? |
| AO4 | Google Ads | What does paid-media evidence support? |
| AO5 | Consumer insights | What should local audience research test? |

Five objectives are project workstreams, not five completed analyses.
:::

### Column {width=45%}

::: {.card fill="false" title="Evidence map — what each source can support"}
| Evidence source | Role in the project | Interpretation boundary |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Website audit | Review navigation, content, and UX | Audit observations are not conversion effects |
| SEO / competitors | Benchmark public search and content evidence | Visibility does not establish patient acquisition |
| Google Ads | Historical platform evidence; validation required | Calls and local actions are not verified patients |
| Survey | Planned consumer-insights research | No collected responses are shown |
| GA4 | Prospective measurement after correction and validation | Property/tag mismatch remains a measurement limitation |

This is a qualitative evidence inventory, not a completion score or client KPI table.
:::

## Reading the dashboard {.flow}

::: {.card fill="false" title="Design and source notes"}
The first row answers “what is the scope?”; the tables then connect each objective to a decision and an evidence boundary. A scrolling layout lets tables retain readable text and stack on narrow screens. Value boxes emphasize factual project descriptors; they do not display invented performance figures.

**Source:** [Group 6 CEP report — October 16 planning snapshot](https://sheilaaa0312.github.io/Group-6-PhD-Orthodontics/cep-group-6-report.html#analytics-objectives). Only high-level project context is summarized here. No exports, account identifiers, respondent records, or restricted source links are included.
